notes.subject: לשלום מר לי מר
notes.rationale: 'bitterness was for me peace' — KJV/ASV 'for peace I had great bitterness' vs YLT 'He changed for me bitterness to peace'; word order deliberately ambiguous

notes.subject: מר ... מר
notes.rationale: doubling of מר (bitter) as noun then verb — 'bitterness ... embittered me' — repetition lost

notes.subject: nefes
notes.rationale: נפש is throat/life-force, rendered as 'nefes bilong mi' keeping the Hebrew shape

notes.subject: בלי משחת
notes.rationale: 'from the pit of בלי' — 'pit of corruption/nothingness' (KJV) vs 'without corruption' (YLT)

translation: Lukluk, long gutpela taim sot bilong mi sot tru; tasol yu yu holimpas nefes bilong mi, long wanem yu no larim em i go daun long hol bilong bagarap — long wanem yu trowim i go bihain long bek bilong yu olgeta sin bilong mi.
